cc:Work.dc:title: G1 · new minus old combat replacement on the same frozen panel
cc:Work.dc:description: fresh_start_v1 · BOSS2 resampled win and HP loss are primary for full fits; all other groups and unsalted cells descriptive. 95% whole-source-WORLD CIs, equal-world weighting; all salts/starts within a WORLD stay together. Salt −1 is separate from salts 0–7. HP loss = initial salted entry HP − battle-exit HP BEFORE end-of-fight relic healing; deaths use zero exit HP. Negative HP loss difference favors new. No margins. ◇ = degenerate empirical bootstrap (constant observed contrast); it does not imply zero population uncertainty.

g.text: G1 · new minus old combat replacement on the same frozen panel
fresh_start_v1 · BOSS2 resampled win and HP loss are primary for full fits; all other groups and unsalted cells descriptive.
95% whole-source-WORLD CIs, equal-world weighting; all salts/starts within a WORLD stay together. Salt −1 is separate from salts 0–7.
HP loss = initial salted entry HP − battle-exit HP BEFORE end-of-fight relic healing; deaths use zero exit HP. Negative HP loss difference favors new. No margins.
◇ = degenerate empirical bootstrap (constant observed contrast); it does not imply zero population uncertainty.
